title: Llama Cookbook
summary: Meta's official guide to building with Llama, covering inference, fine-tuning and RAG across end-to-end use cases. One of those use cases evaluates LLM-based evaluators on synthetic tabular data. SDV supplies that notebook's data: `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and the demo-dataset loader are imported in `evals_with_synthetic_data.ipynb` to manufacture the benchmark tables the evaluator is scored on.

title: AI Agents Projects and Tutorials
summary: A collection of agent tutorials covering multi-agent systems, memory, planning and reasoning loops, with one notebook devoted to synthetic data creation. That notebook is an end-to-end SDV walkthrough: `Metadata`, `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `evaluate_quality` are used in sequence, so the tutorial teaches the full fit-sample-score loop rather than one call.

title: SDG: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A framework for generating structured tabular data, with a plugin model registry and chunked fitting for tables larger than memory. Three SDV-family libraries are vendored under `sdgx/models/components/` as `sdv_ctgan`, `sdv_copulas` and `sdv_rdt`; the shipped `CTGANSynthesizerModel` declares itself modified from the vendored `CTGANSynthesizer`, adding chunked `fit`, and the statistical synthesizer wraps the vendored copulas. SDV supplies the entire model and transform layer this framework re-exposes behind its own API.

title: Oransim
summary: A causal digital twin for marketing, simulating campaign outcomes before spend. SDV is named only as a plan: a docstring in the Bayesian-network synthesizer records `CTGANSynthesizer` as being on the v0.5 roadmap. Nothing imports it and no dependency is declared, so the entry records an intention rather than a use.
evidence: backend/oransim/data/synthesizers/bayes_net.py:21 (roadmap comment only; no import, no dependency)

title: Vibeship Spawner Skills
summary: A directory of several hundred structured skills for coding agents, distributed as instruction files rather than executable packages. One skill packages SDV as a callable capability: `ai/synthetic-data/collaboration.yaml` defines a TypeScript client whose `generateTabular` embeds a Python script importing `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer`, detecting metadata and sampling, while `evaluateQuality` runs `evaluate_quality` and returns its Column Shapes and Column Pair Trends scores. The code runs when an agent invokes the pattern; the repository itself declares no SDV dependency.

title: NeuralNine YouTube Tutorials
summary: Companion code for a Python tutorial channel, one directory per video topic. The synthetic-data episode is built on SDV: `SingleTableMetadata` and `CTGANSynthesizer` are the whole of the notebook, making this a teaching artifact for the single-table API.

title: AutoSOTA
summary: A leaderboard of research codebases automatically optimized by an agent, holding the best generated implementation for each of about a hundred papers. SDV recurs inside the generated code rather than the framework: CTGAN and TVAE are imported as augmentation baselines in the CRDA entry, `copulas` and `ctgan` are pinned in generated requirements files, and SDMetrics' `QualityReport` and `DiagnosticReport` score density in another. The index records SDV as a component the agent reaches for unprompted.

title: Wayland
summary: An agent platform organized around a library of skill definitions the agent loads at run time. Its synthetic-data skill packages SDV as a capability the agent can invoke, with `Metadata`, `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and `CTGANSynthesizer` in a runnable example. SDV is executed on demand rather than declared as a dependency of the platform.

title: TabDDPM
summary: Official implementation of TabDDPM, a diffusion model for tabular data, with training, tuning and evaluation pipelines over the paper's benchmark datasets. CTGAN and TVAE serve as the comparison arm: `sdv-dev/CTGAN` v0.5.2.dev0 is vendored whole under `CTGAN/CTGAN/`, `TVAESynthesizer` is driven from `train_sample_tvae.py`, and RDT is pinned for the transform layer. The README lists it under Baselines against the SDV repository.

title: DeltaPy
summary: A toolkit of tabular augmentation and feature-engineering transforms, organized by transformation family. CTGAN is one of the synthesis options the documentation offers, imported directly as `CTGANSynthesizer` in the README's extraction section. It sits alongside a dozen non-SDV transforms rather than underpinning the library.

title: LAW: Latent World Model
summary: An end-to-end autonomous driving method built on a latent world model, published at ICLR 2025. A full scan of the repository found no SDV import, dependency or reference of any kind. The entry is retained at importance 0 to record that the pooled match was a false positive rather than an unread repository.

title: Zorai
summary: A persistent multi-agent execution platform whose daemon owns work, memory, approvals and long-running goals, with a bundled library of scientific skills. One of those skills is SDV, at `skills/scientific-skills/sdv/`, packaging `CTGANSynthesizer`, the multi-table `HMA1Synthesizer` and `sdv.evaluation` as procedures the agent can call. The skill targets a pre-1.0 API surface, so an agent following it would call names current SDV no longer exposes — a dating signal worth carrying for this class of entry.

title: Data Analyst Augmentation Framework
summary: An open-source toolkit that turns a coding agent into a quantitative research assistant, shipped as a set of skills and reference documents. Its synthetic-data workflow does more than reference SDV: it rules on where SDV may be used. SDV is the Tier-4 local synthesis path, fit on real rows only inside the analyst's own environment, and is explicitly excluded from profile-only generation because its synthesizers require microdata the framework never holds; `Metadata` and `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` appear in the reference implementation.

title: Privacy and Data Protection Skills
summary: A machine-readable database of several hundred privacy and data-protection skills for AI agents, indexed against GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA and comparable regimes. Its data-sharing skill prescribes SDV as the technical control and packages it as a runnable procedure: `SingleTableMetadata`, the three single-table synthesizers, and both `run_diagnostic` and `evaluate_quality` appear in the executable pattern. The entry records SDV written into compliance guidance an agent can act on.

title: NANDA Servers
summary: A catalogue of MCP servers, each exposing a capability to agents over the Model Context Protocol. One server is an SDV wrapper: `mcp-synthetic-data-generator/server.py` imports `SingleTableMetadata` and `CTGANSynthesizer` and pins `sdv==1.8.0`, so SDV is the engine behind a tool an agent can call. Unlike the skill-file entries this is a declared runtime dependency.

title: Oracle Technology Engineering
summary: Oracle's collection of demos, workshops and hands-on guides across its cloud and data-science products. The data-augmentation guide for Oracle Data Science is an SDV walkthrough, using `SingleTableMetadata` and `CTGANSynthesizer` to enhance a customer dataset. It records a vendor positioning SDV inside its own platform documentation.

That directory vendors a copy of `ctgan` and imports `CTGANSynthesizer` from it in the shared utilities, making CTGAN the tabular generator behind the experiments rather than a cited method.

title: CosmosAIGraph
summary: A reference implementation of the OmniRAG pattern over Azure Cosmos DB, combining vector search with an in-memory graph database. A full scan found no SDV import, dependency or mention. title: Allie
summary: An automated machine-learning framework spanning audio, text, image, video and CSV inputs, with fifty featurizers and a dozen model trainers. CTGAN is its tabular augmentation strategy: `augment_ctgan_classification.py` imports `CTGANSynthesizer`, and the installer pins `ctgan==0.2.1`. It is one augmentation module among several, invoked only for CSV inputs.

title: PyTrial
summary: A platform for applying machine learning across drug-development tasks, including patient-record simulation for clinical trials. Its trial-simulation module is built on the SDV stack: separate synthesizers wrap `GaussianMultivariate` from copulas, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer`, while evaluation imports `sdmetrics` directly. SDV supplies both the generative models and the scoring for the tabular half of the platform.

title: Skills for Antigravity
summary: A skills library packaged for a commercial agent workspace, several hundred instruction files deep. Its synthetic-data reference packages the three SDV single-table synthesizers plus `SingleTableMetadata` and `evaluate_quality` as a callable pattern. The file is near-identical to those in other skill libraries in this batch, suggesting a shared upstream rather than independent authorship.

title: Vincent Granville, Main
summary: Companion material for a set of books on synthetic data and generative AI, mixing code with expository documents. Two scripts exercise SDV directly, one comparing a copula-based GAN against SDV's demo datasets and another using `SingleTableMetadata`. SDV appears as the reference implementation an author writes against while arguing for an alternative.

title: DP-CGANS
summary: A library generating differentially private synthetic tabular and RDF data with conditional GANs, aimed at biomedical data sharing. It is built by modification: the ontology-aware model wraps `CTGANSynthesizer`, its hyper-transformer is derived from RDT with the original imports left commented in place, and copulas is a declared dependency. The differential-privacy layer is the addition; the generative core is CTGAN's.

title: Bank Account Fraud dataset suite
summary: Supporting code for the NeurIPS Bank Account Fraud dataset suite, a set of biased, imbalanced and temporally shifting tabular datasets for evaluating fraud models. CTGAN is the generator behind the published data: a dedicated training notebook fits `ctgan.CTGANSynthesizer` and `ctgan==0.4.3` is pinned. The privacy properties of a widely used public benchmark rest on it.

title: Machine Learning for Financial Risk Management

title: Misata

Synthetic user data generated for simulation is scored with SDV's metrics.

title: ytopt

An unusual use, generating configurations rather than data records.

title: Synthetic Data Release privacy evaluation
summary: The evaluation framework from Stadler et al., testing whether synthetic data publishing delivers its claimed privacy-utility tradeoff, via linkage and attribute-inference attacks against published generators. CTGAN is one of the generators put under attack: `generative_models/ctgan.py` wraps `CTGANSynthesizer` behind the framework's common interface. The entry matters because it is adversarial evaluation of SDV rather than use of it.
